context.title: Vista Fire Fighters Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Vista Unified School District — Measure N (Vista Unified School District School Improvement Bond of 2026)

positions.statement: Michael Saldaña (President, Vista Fire Fighters Association) signed the rebuttal to the argument against Vista Unified School District Measure N in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
